marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Women at work : perspective on workplace and family

This book is based on selected papers presented at the Biennial National Conference of the Malaysian Psychological Association (PSIMA) on July 31 - 2, 2005. It contains state-of-the art research on women at work conducted by Malaysian psychologists. Anyone who is interested in women research in Malaysia and who works towards a universal psychology will find this volume informative and useful. This book is important to those who are working in Malaysia or with Malaysians since it privides in-depth insights into the fundamental applications and theories of women at work and psychology which will help them in their interface with Malaysia.
